name: Unknown Game Mashiro
original_name: アンノウンゲームマシロ
source:
Love between a death game participant and a death game organizer?!

I (Kurosaki), who was forced to participate in a death game, finally lost.

"If you tell me a story that entertains me, I can make use of it. It's okay ♪" suggested Mashiro, its organizer.

In order to survive, I have no choice but to live up to Mashiro's expectations.

I'm horrified at my memorable first love...

Mashiro and Kurosaki's true intentions and the ending!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/29063]Freem![/url]]
translation:
死亡游戏参与者与死亡游戏组织者之间的爱情？！

被迫参加死亡游戏的我（黑崎饰）终于输了。

“如果你告诉我一个让我开心的故事，我可以利用它。没关系♪”组织者真白建议道。

为了生存，我只能不辜负真白的期望。

我对我难忘的初恋感到震惊……

真白和黑崎的真实意图和结局！

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/29063]Freem![/url]]
